title: Tamil Nadu GSDP by industry of origin, 2004-05 base, current prices, factor cost
source_agency: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (CSO state series, as on 31-07-2015)
method_note: This is the GSDP vintage contemporaneous with the 2007 policy's 21%-to-27% manufacturing-share target; the current 2011-12-base GSVA series starts after the deadline. Values are at factor cost and current prices. The policy does not state its price concept, so the share is also cross-checked against the 2011-12-base GSVA series, which gives 21.9% in 2011-12; both series place the share far below 27%.
